pooled.tie_policy: exclude a pair if either arm tied

GymLeader.direction: C minus D; negative favors C
GymLeader.tie_policy: exclude a pair if either arm tied

RandomBaseline.direction: C minus D; negative favors C

semantics.policy: masked BC loss and accuracy on eligible decisions
semantics.nonforced: eligible decisions with more than one legal action
semantics.value: all pre-action decisions, including BC-ineligible steps
semantics.sequence: full trajectories; hidden state reset only at trajectory start
semantics.joint: ablation only; failed preregistered policy delta gate 0.0155 > 0.01

selection: descriptive fixed-arm evaluation only; no model selection
